text:
sre-lead: Quick postmortem follow-up — want a compact action board for the streaming/chat partial-response/timeouts incident. I sketched a small sprint plan below, please ack or update owners/timelines.

sre-lead: TL;DR: recurring partial responses on long sessions + reconnect storms on client retries. Preliminary root causes: handshake timeout too aggressive, KV cache invalidation edge-case, and client backoff not jittered.

maria: I'll own metrics work to get per-connection error counters and prefix mismatch traces. Target: 2d.

aj: I'll do the reconnect backoff fix — implement exponential backoff + jitter in client library and add server-side connection-throttle. ETA: client 3d, server 2d.

devon: I'll take the KV cache invalidation fix and add unit + integration tests. ETA: 4d. Will plan a canary.

product_pm: Need to know customer impact window and which customers to notify. @sre-lead can you draft a customer-facing note?

sre-lead: Will draft a short customer note today and update the status page if needed. Also proposing daily 30m stand for the next 4 days to unblock.

oncall-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0422. Added owners: maria, aj, devon. Severity: P2. Related doc: https://pm.internal/INC-2026-0422

maria: Quick question — do we want synthetic E2E tests that simulate 10k concurrent streaming sessions? That might spike infra costs.

eng-manager: Yes but run scaled tests incrementally in staging with infra windows. I can coordinate the infra reservation and runbooks.

aj: For the client lib I'll add a feature flag for the new backoff behaviour and flip for 10% traffic on canary.

devon: Rollout suggestion: canary 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 30m observation windows. Revert if error rate regresses by +0.5%.

maria: Dashboards I will add: per-conn error, partial-response-rate, avg-handshake-latency, reconnect-rate. ETA 2d.

product_pm: Timeline sounds good. If we need to contact customers, please use the drafted note and coordinate with me before posting.

sre-lead: Action board (short):
- A1: per-connection metrics & traces (owner: maria, ETA: 2d)
- A2: client backoff + feature flag (owner: aj, ETA: 3d)
- A3: KV cache invalidation fix + tests (owner: devon, ETA: 4d)
- A4: canary rollout plan (owners: devon+aj, ETA: today)
- A5: customer note + status page update (owner: sre-lead, ETA: today)
I'll put this into a shared doc and maintain a live checklist.

ops-bot: Reminder set for daily stand 10:00 PST (next 4 days).

eng-sre: One more ask — add a blackbox probe to detect partial responses within 5s of session end, so we can alert before customers notice.

maria: Acked, will add the blackbox probe as part of the metrics work.

aj: Pushing client lib PR now, will paste link once CI passes.

sre-lead: Thanks everyone. Paste PRs and doc links here. We'll review in the daily stand and close the loop in the next all-hands.
